facts.fact_text: Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 5 that assemblies may be held only after the organisers have duly notified the urban mayor's (municipal) or rural offices.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 11(1) that the organiser of an assembly must lodge a notification with the mayor's office at least fifteen days before the chosen date, according to the model provided in the appendix to that law.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 11(2) that the preliminary notification should indicate the name of the organiser and the aim of the assembly.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 11(2) that the preliminary notification should indicate the date and time the assembly is to begin and end.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 11(2) that the preliminary notification should indicate where the assembly will take place and the routes to and from the place.
Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 11(2) that the preliminary notification should indicate the form the assembly will take.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 11(2) that the preliminary notification should indicate the approximate number of participants.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 11(2) that the preliminary notification should indicate those appointed to ensure the good conduct of the assembly and to be responsible for it.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 11(2) that the preliminary notification should indicate the services the organisers require from the mayor's office.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 11(3) that the Mayor's Office may in justified cases modify, with the organiser's consent, elements of the preliminary notification.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 13 that after examining the preliminary declaration, the Mayor's Office shall issue one of the following decisions and inform the organiser: grant permission, or refuse permission under section 12(6).
Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 15(1) that the organiser can contest the refusal to authorise an assembly.

Law no. 560-XIII of 21 July 1995 regarding the organisation and conduct of assemblies provides under Section 15(2) that the relevant judicial body shall decide upon the organiser's contestation within 5 days from its lodging.

In their submissions to the Chişinău Court of Appeal on re-examination, the Chişinău Mayor's Office argued that the holding of an assembly for the promotion of the rights of sexual minorities would endanger public order.

In their submissions to the Chişinău Court of Appeal on re-examination, the Chişinău Mayor's Office argued that the holding of an assembly for the promotion of the rights of sexual minorities would endanger social morality.
